University Profile

Ganpat University (GUNI), established in 2005 under the Government of Gujarat Act, is a leading private university situated in Ganpat Vidyanagar, Kherva, Mehsana. Spanning across a lush green 300-acre high-tech campus, GUNI is recognized for its strong corporate partnerships, unique industry-linked programs, and modern infrastructure. GUNI fosters academic excellence, entrepreneurship, and hands-on skills to ensure high levels of student employability.

Approvals & Recognitions

UGC Recognized

Empowered under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956 to award degrees.

AICTE & PCI Approved

Technical programs approved by AICTE; pharmacy programs approved by Pharmacy Council of India.

COA Approved

Architecture programs verified and approved by the Council of Architecture.

Campus Highlights

  • Lush green 300-acre residential campus with state-of-the-art labs.
  • Industry-linked academies including IBM, SAS, and Bosch Rexroth.
  • High-speed fiber connectivity and fully computerized library resources.
  • Separate secure residential hostels for boys and girls.
  • Dedicated Placement Cell with relationships in TCS, Shalby, IBM, etc.
